field.label: Type
field.help: A resolver entered here, or the nameservers read from a resolv.conf-style file.

field.label: Content
field.help: For a resolver: e.g. 1.1.1.1, tcp+udp:9.9.9.9, tcp-tls:dns.quad9.net or https://dns.quad9.net/dns-query. A plain resolver must be an IP address, because Blocky rejects a host name it would have to resolve first; a DoT, DoH or DoQ resolver may use a host name if its addresses are pinned below. For a resolv file: the absolute path to a resolv.conf-style file, e.g. /etc/resolv.conf, which must list at least one nameserver Blocky can reach and must not point back at Blocky.

field.label: Pinned IPs
field.help: Addresses of the resolver above, needed whenever it is given as a host name so it can be reached without a lookup. Leave empty when the resolver is an IP address. Blocky refuses to start if a host name has no addresses here.
